comparison.objective: Place PCB support pins under a pick-and-place board while avoiding underside components; candidate breaks and recovers insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Occlusion-aware support placement and collision avoidance versus coaxial mandrel insertion, regulated striking, fracture, and loose-fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Board supported with pins clear of underside parts versus four fractured tangs in a tray and no coil or shell damage. Pin-clearance rubric is unspecified.
comparison.reason: Both involve precision around delicate geometry, but support placement does not test impact fracture or post-fracture containment.
